scope: Full sequential rebuild using the public project layout on the recorded Windows production environment.
dependency_setup: Used the already installed production packages through PYTHONPATH and selected the installed FFmpeg with FFMPEG_BINARY; no per-machine paths are required by the public scripts.
limits: This is a same-environment fixed-asset reproduction, not a fresh dependency installation on every supported platform.
Byte equality does not establish subjective approval of every frame.
This does not imply deterministic regeneration of artwork.
